subject: 起飛性能 - 跑道長度需求 (Takeoff Performance - Field Length Requirements)

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據影片內容,若引擎失效發生在起飛決定速度 (V1) 之後,飛行員應如何處理?
zh_options: (A) 立即執行最大手動煞車並中斷起飛
(B) 必須繼續完成起飛 (Continue the takeoff)
(C) 視賸餘跑道長度決定是否中斷
(D) 減小另一具引擎推力以保持方向控制
mc_questions.en_question: According to the video, if an engine failure occurs after the takeoff decision speed (V1), what should the crew do?
en_options: (A) Immediately apply maximum manual braking and reject the takeoff
(B) The crew must continue the takeoff
(C) Decide whether to reject based on remaining runway length
(D) Reduce thrust on the remaining engine to maintain directional control
mc_questions.explanation: 影片明確指出,若首個煞車動作無法在 V1 之前啟動,則組員必須繼續起飛 (The crew must continue the takeoff),因為此時剩餘跑道已不足以安全減速停下。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在乾跑道 (Dry runway) 的單發失效情況下,飛機必須在跑道盡頭達到多少的高度 (Screen Height)?
mc_questions.en_question: In the case of a one-engine inoperative takeoff on a dry runway, what is the required height (Screen Height) at the end of the runway?
mc_questions.explanation: 影片提到 dry runway 的 Screen Height 要求為 35 呎,而 wet runway 則為 15 呎。

mc_questions.zh_question: 何謂「平衡欄場長度」(Balanced Field Length)?
zh_options: (A) 全引擎起飛距離與單發失效起飛距離相等時的長度
(B) 加速停止距離 (Accelerate-stop distance) 等於單發失效起飛距離時的長度
(C) 飛機加速至 V1 所需的最小跑道距離
(D) 考慮 15% 安全餘裕後的起飛距離
mc_questions.en_question: What is defined as the 'Balanced Field Length'?
en_options: (A) The length when all-engine takeoff distance equals one-engine out takeoff distance
(B) The length where the accelerate-stop distance equals the one-engine inoperative takeoff distance
(C) The minimum runway distance required to accelerate the aircraft to V1
(D) The takeoff distance after considering a 15% safety margin
mc_questions.explanation: Balanced Field Length 發生在加速停止距離與單發失效起飛距離的交點,此時對應的速度稱為 Balanced V1。

cloze_items.cloze_text: For the normal all-engine takeoff, there must be an extra {{c1::15}}% margin of runway available over the actual takeoff distance.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 對於正常的各發動機皆運作之起飛,跑道必須比實際起飛距離多出 15% 的額外餘裕。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是為了確保正常運作下有足夠的安全緩衝空間。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The required screen height above the end of the runway is {{c1::15}} feet for a wet runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 濕跑道的跑道盡頭所需越障高度 (Screen Height) 為 15 呎。
cloze_items.explanation: 相較於乾跑道的 35 呎,濕跑道的要求較低以補償煞車效率下降。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The FAA regulations account for {{c1::1}} second of recognition and reaction time between the event and the crew's initial application of a braking action.
cloze_items.zh_translation: FAA 規章在失效事件發生到組員初次採取煞車行動之間,計入了 1 秒鐘的辨識與反應時間。
cloze_items.explanation: 此時間包含在加速停止距離 (Accelerate-stop distance) 的計算中。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The minimum safe flying speed reached at screen height is called the takeoff safety speed, {{c1::V2}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 在越障高度 (Screen Height) 達到的最小安全飛行速度稱為起飛安全速度, 即 V2。
cloze_items.explanation: V2 是確保單發失效後能安全爬升的速度。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The FAR Field Length is determined by the {{c1::longest}} of the accelerate-stop distance, the engine-out takeoff distance, and the all-engine takeoff distance (with margin).
cloze_items.zh_translation: FAR 欄場長度是由加速停止距離、單發失效起飛距離及全發動機起飛距離(含餘裕)中的最長者所決定。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是性能計算中為了保證安全性所採用的最嚴格(最受限)值。

cloze_items.cloze_text: If the first braking action can be initiated at or prior to {{c1::V1}}, then the crew will be able to reject the takeoff within the available runway.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 如果第一次煞車動作能在 V1 或之前啟動,則組員能在可用跑道內中斷起飛。
cloze_items.explanation: V1 的定義核心在於中斷或繼續起飛的決策邊界。
